payload.title: Workers: private runtime assembly
payload.requestedOutcome: Create the first parent-private Workers subservice at pkg/services/workers/internal/services/runtime_assembly. It owns immutable execution bindings and inert construction only; publish only the Workers root contract and prove no Factory Session back-query or lifecycle activation during construction.

payload.title: Workers: private workstation routing and capacity
payload.requestedOutcome: After runtime assembly is accepted, create pkg/services/workers/internal/services/workstations for capacity, routing, and pool lifecycle. Preserve saturation, fairness, cancellation, and race behavior through the Workers root; do not touch provider migration paths.

payload.title: Workers: private runner registry
payload.requestedOutcome: After runtime assembly is accepted, create pkg/services/workers/internal/services/runners with the common Runner contract and registry plus conformance proof. Do not migrate concrete provider adapters in this packet.

payload.title: Reassess Workers foundation
payload.requestedOutcome: Review accepted Workers foundation outcomes and choose the next owner-disjoint runner or workstation slice.
